_doc: Medic-owned alert classes. Each entry names a (source, subject_prefix) pair the Medic operator consumes from ~/agents/blackboard/larry-alerts.jsonl; alerts that do NOT match any entry are left untouched for Beacon's existing DM path (Medic never swallows alerts it does not own). The action_tier hint biases the operator's classifier toward reversible (PR2 will act + notify) vs privileged (PR2/PR3 will emit approval_request) vs judgment (escalate diagnose-only). PR1 ships escalate-only -- every owned alert becomes a diagnosis + recommended-command notification or an approval-request when the recommended fix is privileged; no remediation action runs. Loader is fail safe: missing or malformed file is treated as empty (no alerts owned).

owned_classes._doc: Inbox-stall: a queued task aged past its watchdog threshold. Reversible remediation is to re-trigger the watcher; PR2 wires the actual restart.

Watchdog critical: a daemon under watchdog supervision crossed its silent threshold. Empty subject_prefix matches any subject; severity gate restricts to critical. Reversible remediation is daemon restart; PR2 wires it.

Pipeline / chain-stall: the headless-handoff gap (forge built but no PR, Mirror PASS but PR still open, etc.). Re-dispatching a stalled chain leg is reversible in principle but requires the correct session_id/source/reply_chat_id -- the manual bridge. PR3 wires it. For PR1 + PR2 these are diagnose-only escalations.

auto-restart-FAILED from the stale-daemon healer: the healer tried to restart a daemon and the restart itself failed. Recovery requires diagnosing why the restart failed (missing binary, env-var rot, journal noise) before any re-try. Diagnose-only in PR1.
